meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: A goal-like loop that decomposes work into systematic, evidence-bound ultrawork steps. Use when the user wants a goal loop or durable, checkpointed execution.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把复杂目标拆成可核验步骤并循环推进
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果面对多步任务且想留痕、按步骤推进
copy.tagline_en: Break complex goals into verifiable steps and iterate to completion
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you face multi-step tasks and want to keep evidence-based progress

howto.what: 它会把一项工作拆成一条条可核查的执行步骤:先按 references/define-goal.md 注册目标和验收标准,再把每一步同步进实时任务清单,要求每条成功标准都有来自真实表面的证据,并留下检查点以便中断后接着跑。
howto.when: 当你要求 ulw-loop、需要带检查点的持久目标执行,或提到手动 QA 时接管;每次命令都要带上会话 --session-id。

howto.what_en: It decomposes a job into granular, evidence-bound steps: registers goals and success criteria, mirrors each step into a live plan checklist, requires observable evidence from a real surface, and resumes from checkpoints.
howto.when_en: Use when the user asks for ulw-loop, for durable checkpointed goal execution, or for manual QA; every command must carry a session --session-id.
